subject: Add boot-time pre-checks for claude and codex CLI versions
description:
In `capo/main.py` startup, run `claude --version` and (if `agents.codex.enabled=true`) `codex --version`; fail fast if missing or below the minimum versions established by S-3 and S-1 respectively (per §12.1 version policy).

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Boot calls `claude --version` and parses the result.
- [ ] If `claude` not on PATH or below the minimum version pin (set by S-3 findings): boot fails with a clear error citing the required version.
- [ ] If `agents.codex.enabled=true` and `codex` not on PATH or below S-1's pin: boot fails with a clear error.
- [ ] Pre-check is fast (< 500ms total).

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] PATH on launchd doesn't include Homebrew: error message tells the user to fix the plist `EnvironmentVariables.PATH` (per §13 risk mitigation).

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: version comparator handles `0.x`, `1.x`, semver suffixes
• Integration: synthesize a "PATH without claude" scenario → boot fails with clear error

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 9.5, 12.1, 13
